title: God Is Our Refuge and Strength

questions.question: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:1 (ESV): "God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble."

questions.question: Therefore we will not fear though the earth gives way, though the mountains be moved into the heart of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:2 (ESV): "...though the mountains be moved into the heart of the sea,"

questions.question: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:4 (ESV): "There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God,"

questions.question: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:5 (ESV): "God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved;"

questions.question: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:7 (ESV): "The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress."

questions.question: Come, behold the works of the Lord, how he has brought desolations on the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:8 (ESV): "...how he has brought desolations on the earth."

questions.question: He makes wars cease to the end of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:9 (ESV): "He makes wars cease to the end of the earth;"

questions.question: He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the chariots with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:9 (ESV): "...he burns the chariots with fire."

questions.question: Be still, and know that I am what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:10 (ESV): "Be still, and know that I am God."

questions.question: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:10 (ESV): "I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth!"

questions.question: Though its waters roar and foam, though the mountains tremble at its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:3 (ESV): "...though the mountains tremble at its swelling."

questions.question: God will help her when what dawns?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:5 (ESV): "God will help her when morning dawns."

questions.question: The nations rage, the kingdoms totter; he utters his voice, the earth does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46:6 (ESV): "...he utters his voice, the earth melts."

questions.question: This Psalm is a song for whom, according to the title?
questions.explanation: Psalm 46 Title: "To the choirmaster. Of the Sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A Song."

questions.question: How many times does the refrain "The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress" appear?

key_verse_text: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth!
